Lifecycle & I/O.name: load
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Loads an existing PowerPoint presentation from a file path (.pptx, .xml, .ppt), directory tree, remote URL, Buffer or stream. Inflates the PKZip container or Flat OPC XML, parses relationships, and mounts the in-memory Virtual File System (VFS).
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Reads ZIP archive entries: [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, ppt/presentation.xml, ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Inspects ZIP magic bytes. Rejects malformed archives and XXE entity expansion attacks.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: File path, directory path, remote HTTP/HTTPS URL, raw binary buffer, readable stream.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options for parser, timeout, headers, and logger.

parameters.name: options.logLevel
parameters.description: Logging verbosity level during parsing and manipulations.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized, chainable PPTXTemplater instance ready for templating operations.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: createBlank
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Creates a minimal, template-free blank PowerPoint presentation in memory from clean, valid OpenXML schemas with custom aspect ratio (16:9, 4:3, 16:10) or custom EMU/pixel dimensions. Contains 1 initial blank slide.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Synthesizes minimal [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, presentation.xml with specified dimensions, slideMaster1.xml, slideLayout1.xml, theme1.xml, and slide1.xml.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Accepts '16:9', '4:3', '16:10' string aliases or explicit { width, height } in EMUs or pixels. Rejects invalid dimension inputs with PPTXError.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Creation options including aspect ratio, dimensions, and theme settings.

parameters.name: options.aspectRatio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio preset for slide canvas dimensions.

parameters.name: options.width
parameters.description: Custom slide width in EMUs (or pixels if options.unit is 'px').

parameters.name: options.height
parameters.description: Custom slide height in EMUs (or pixels if options.unit is 'px').

parameters.name: options.unit
parameters.description: Unit of measurement for custom dimensions.

returns.description: Resolves to an initialized PPTXTemplater instance with a single blank slide ready for adding content.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractPptx
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Unpacks a binary .pptx file into a folder of formatted OpenXML documents for automated inspection, security auditing, or batch transformation.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Extracts and formats [Content_Types].xml, ppt/presentation.xml, slide XML, and relationships.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: pptxPath
parameters.description: Path to source .pptx file.

parameters.name: destinationFolder
parameters.description: Destination folder for unpacked OpenXML assets.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Extraction options.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: buildPptx
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Compiles an extracted OpenXML directory back into a valid, zipped PowerPoint presentation file. Guarantees proper zip compression and relationship integrity.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Scans directory, preserves binary media bytes, and zips back to compliant PresentationML package.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Source folder containing extracted OpenXML files.

parameters.name: outputPath
parameters.description: Target destination .pptx file path.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: preload
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Pre-reads, inflates, and caches a PPTX template into a high-speed memory cache. Subsequent calls to PPTXTemplater.fromCache() clone this pre-parsed memory state directly, eliminating disk reads and zip decompression overhead.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Caches inflated OpenXML parts in memory; avoids repeating JSZip.loadAsync on heavy batch jobs.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Inspects ZIP magic bytes. Rejects malformed archives and XXE entity expansion attacks.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Template file path or binary Buffer to inflate and cache.

returns.description: Resolves to the preloaded VirtualFileSystem representation stored in the global cache.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: fromCache
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Instantiates a new PPTXTemplater by deep-cloning an existing preloaded template cache. Delivers up to 10x higher throughput for concurrent report generation in high-concurrency API servers and cloud functions.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Fast deep-copies the virtual OpenXML byte tree without reading from disk or re-parsing the zip container.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Cache key (file path string or Buffer identifier) previously passed to preload().

returns.description: Resolves to an isolated, ready-to-mutate PPTXTemplater instance.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: clearCache
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Clears all cached template packages from memory. Ideal for test teardown, memory reclamation, or when template files on disk have been hot-reloaded.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Flushes global in-memory maps holding pre-inflated OpenXML byte arrays.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: saveToFile
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire in-memory PresentationML package, generates a standardized PKZip archive with DEFLATE compression, and writes the output file to disk. Creates any missing parent directories automatically.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Recompresses all modified XML parts (ppt/slides/slide*.xml, [Content_Types].xml, etc.) into compliant binary PPTX container.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: outputPath
parameters.description: Target destination file path where the generated .pptx will be saved.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Export configuration options.

parameters.name: options.compressionLevel
parameters.description: Zip compression level from 1 (fastest) to 9 (maximum compression).

returns.description: Resolves once the file stream has completely flushed and closed on disk.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toBuffer
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire PowerPoint presentation into an in-memory Node.js binary Buffer. Essential for serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Vercel Functions, Google Cloud Run) where local disk writes are prohibited or ephemeral.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Compresses all OpenXML package parts directly into memory without touching the filesystem.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Serialization configuration.

parameters.name: options.compression
parameters.description: Zip compression algorithm.

returns.description: Resolves to a binary Node.js Buffer containing the complete, valid .pptx file.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toStream
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Returns a Node.js Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the compressed PPTX archive. Enables streaming responses with low memory footprints when producing massive decks.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Streams zipped binary data directly from internal archive compression pipeline.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Stream configuration options.

returns.description: Resolves to a Readable stream emitting binary chunks of the presentation.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toBase64
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the presentation archive and returns it as a Base64 string or full Data URI string (data:application/vnd...;base64,...). Ideal for JSON API responses, client downloads, or webhook payloads.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Converts in-memory zipped binary buffer into Base64 encoding.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Formatting options.

parameters.name: options.dataUri
parameters.description: When true, prepends MIME type data URI scheme.

returns.description: Resolves to the base64-encoded presentation string.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toArrayBuffer
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes presentation into a raw in-memory ArrayBuffer, ideal for Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Fetch API streaming.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Flushes VirtualFileSystem into an uncompressed or compressed PKZip ArrayBuffer payload.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Returns standard ArrayBuffer compatible with Web Streams and Edge Response objects.

returns.description: Resolves to binary ArrayBuffer representing the PPTX archive.

Lifecycle & I/O.exampleCode:
const arrayBuffer = await ppt.toArrayBuffer();
return new Response(arrayBuffer, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' } });

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toResponse
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Compiles the presentation and returns a web-standard Web API Response object with binary ArrayBuffer body, correct OpenXML Content-Type headers, and optional Content-Disposition attachment header. Ideal for Next.js Route Handlers, Remix, SvelteKit, and Edge workers.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Serializes VirtualFileSystem into PKZip binary buffer wrapped in standard Response.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Encodes Unicode filenames safely into RFC-5987 Content-Disposition header.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Response configuration options.

parameters.name: options.filename
parameters.description: Suggested download filename.

parameters.name: options.status
parameters.description: HTTP response status code.

parameters.name: options.headers
parameters.description: Additional HTTP response headers.

returns.description: Resolves to a standard Web API Response object.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toExpress
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Streams the presentation directly to an Express.js response object. Automatically sets the correct OpenXML MIME type (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation), Content-Disposition attachment header with encoded filename, and Content-Length.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Direct HTTP response serialization with standardized OpenXML MIME headers.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Throws PPTXError if presentation package is uninitialized or invalid.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Active Express HTTP response object.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Filename suggested to the user client browser for download.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Additional streaming and header options.

returns.description: Resolves when the response transmission completes.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toFastify
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Pipes the presentation binary Buffer directly to a Fastify reply instance with correct OpenXML MIME type, Content-Length, and Content-Disposition download headers.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Serializes in-memory presentation into binary buffer dispatched through Fastify reply pipeline.

parameters.name: reply
parameters.description: Active Fastify reply object.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Download filename for client browser.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Additional export and header options.

returns.description: Resolves to the Fastify reply once transmitted.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractToZip
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Packages the in-memory presentation and writes a raw compressed PKZip archive file to disk. Ensures all directories exist before writing.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Serializes entire VirtualFileSystem into compressed ZIP container written to destinationPath.

parameters.name: destinationPath
parameters.description: Target file path for the output ZIP archive.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: ZIP compression options.

returns.description: Resolves once archive file is written to disk.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: extractToXml
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Unpacks all OpenXML presentation parts (slides, charts, relationships, content types, themes) into an uncompressed folder on disk. Supports formatting and pretty-printing XML files for version control inspection.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Writes individual files into directory structure mirroring the OpenXML package ([Content_Types].xml, _rels/, ppt/slides/, etc.).
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Preserves binary media files as raw buffers while optionally formatting XML documents with indentation.

parameters.name: destinationDir
parameters.description: Target folder path on disk where parts will be unpacked.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Extraction options.

parameters.name: options.formatXml
parameters.description: When true, pretty-prints XML files with 2-space indentation for readable diffs and code review.

returns.description: Resolves once all presentation files have been written to the destination directory.

Lifecycle & I/O.name: toFlatXml
Lifecycle & I/O.description: Serializes the entire in-memory presentation into a Microsoft Flat OPC XML string (<pkg:package>). If a file path string is provided, writes directly to local disk and returns the XML string. If options are provided or omitted, returns the XML string directly in memory.
Lifecycle & I/O.openXmlImpact: Constructs a valid ISO/IEC 29500-2 Flat OPC XML document from the current VirtualFileSystem state without disk or ZIP overhead.
Lifecycle & I/O.edgeCases: Infers OpenXML MIME types for all parts and strips root [Content_Types].xml which is not part of Flat OPC schema.

parameters.name: destinationPathOrOptions
parameters.description: Destination file path string to save the XML file on disk, or formatting options object.

returns.description: Resolves to the serialized Flat OPC XML string.

Slides.name: useSlide
Slides.description: Selects one or more slides to target for subsequent operations (adding shapes, text, tables, charts, or modifying layout). Can be chained or stored in a variable as an isolated slide handle.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Sets internal presentation selection state and mounts slide XML (ppt/slides/slideN.xml) into memory.
Slides.edgeCases: Supports 1-based indexing, string identifiers, and tags. Throws SlideNotFoundError if the slide index exceeds slideCount.

parameters.name: slideRefs
parameters.description: 1-based slide index number, ID string, or custom tag name.

returns.description: Returns the active slide context (or presentation engine) for method chaining.

Slides.name: useAllSlides
Slides.description: Selects all slides across the presentation. Subsequent operations (such as global text replacements, watermarks, or styling) will be applied across every slide.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Sets target selection context to all slide XML parts.
Slides.edgeCases: No-op on empty decks.

returns.description: Chainable presentation instance targeting all slides.

Slides.exampleCode: ppt.useAllSlides().replaceText({ '{{CONFIDENTIAL}}': 'INTERNAL USE ONLY' });

Slides.name: addSlide
Slides.description: Adds a new slide to the presentation. If position is omitted or exceeds slideCount, it appends to the end; if position < 0 or 0, it inserts at the first position; otherwise it inserts at that position and shifts remaining slides forward.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Creates ppt/slides/slideM.xml and ppt/slides/_rels/slideM.xml.rels, appends reference to <p:sldIdLst> in presentation.xml, and updates [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Normalizes out-of-bounds positions: < 0 becomes 1; > totalSlides becomes totalSlides + 1.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Slide creation configuration (layout name, title, initial elements, or layout index).

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: 1-based insertion index. Clamped to 1 if < 0, clamped to slideCount + 1 if > slideCount.

Slides.name: duplicateSlide
Slides.description: Duplicates an existing slide including layout, elements, and properties. If sourceIndex is not specified, it duplicates the last slide. If atPosition is not specified or > slideCount, inserts at the last position; if < 0, inserts at the first position.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Clones slide XML and .rels file, re-maps relationship IDs, allocates a unique 32-bit slide ID in <p:sldIdLst>, and updates [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Clones all shapes, animations, notes, and embedded charts safely to prevent OpenXML corruption.

parameters.name: sourceIndex
parameters.description: 1-based index of the slide to duplicate. Defaults to the last slide.

parameters.name: atPosition
parameters.description: 1-based destination index for the cloned slide. Clamped within [1, slideCount + 1].

returns.description: Resolves to the chainable presentation engine.

Slides.name: removeSlide
Slides.description: Removes a slide at a specific position. If position is omitted or > slideCount, removes the last slide. If position < 0, removes the first slide. Remaining subsequent slides shift backward.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Deletes <p:sldId> from ppt/presentation.xml, purges relationships, removes [Content_Types].xml override, and deletes slide XML from the VFS.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws error if attempting to delete the only remaining slide in the presentation.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: 1-based position to delete. Clamped to 1 if < 0, clamped to slideCount if > slideCount.

Slides.name: getSlides
Slides.description: Returns an array of all slides in the deck with comprehensive metadata including placeholders, titles, text, media, tables, charts, animations, transitions, notes, dimensions, and layout properties.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Parses all slide XML files, relationships, notes, masters, and presentation manifests in read-only mode.
Slides.edgeCases: Returns structured empty arrays/objects for slides with missing optional components (e.g. without Cameo or 3D models).

returns.description: Array of slide detail objects containing elements, dimensions, animations, notes, transitions, and z-index ordering.

Slides.name: getSlide
Slides.description: Returns full metadata and elements of a single slide. If index is not specified, returns the slide currently active via useSlide().
Slides.openXmlImpact: Reads and decodes the target slide's DrawingML, PresentationML, and relationship graph.
Slides.edgeCases: Clamps out-of-range index to 1 (if < 0) or slideCount (if > slideCount).

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 1-based slide index. Defaults to current active slide if omitted.

returns.description: Complete slide metadata object (placeholders, shapes, tables, charts, background, dimensions, speaker notes, animations, Cameo, etc.).

Slides.name: importSlideFrom
Slides.description: Imports a slide from another PPTX instance into this presentation. Can be customized before insertion. Inserts at position (defaults to end; clamps < 0 to start, > slideCount to end) and shifts remaining slides.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Copies slide AST, deduplicates masters/layouts/media, generates non-colliding relationship IDs, and registers new parts in [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Source deck must be loaded. Automatically deduplicates assets to avoid PowerPoint repair prompts.

parameters.name: sourcePpt
parameters.description: Source PPTXTemplater instance.

parameters.name: sourceIndex
parameters.description: 1-based index or tag of slide in source presentation.

parameters.name: atPosition
parameters.description: 1-based insertion position in target presentation. Defaults to append.

Slides.name: exportSlides
Slides.description: Exports selected slides to a new standalone PPTXTemplater instance. If slideIndices is omitted, exports the currently targeted slide(s).
Slides.openXmlImpact: Constructs a new PresentationML container including only referenced slides, re-binding layouts, themes, and embedded assets.
Slides.edgeCases: Clones master slides and required relationships so the exported deck opens independently without corruption.

parameters.name: slideIndices
parameters.description: 1-based slide indices to export into the new presentation.

returns.description: Resolves to a new, isolated PPTXTemplater instance containing only exported slides.

Slides.name: moveSlide
Slides.description: Moves a slide from one position to another within the presentation, shifting intermediate slides accordingly.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Reorders <p:sldId> nodes in <p:sldIdLst> in ppt/presentation.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Validates 1-based indices against slideCount.

parameters.name: fromIndex
parameters.description: 1-based source position.

parameters.name: toIndex
parameters.description: 1-based target destination position.

Slides.exampleCode: ppt.moveSlide(3, 1); // Move slide 3 to the beginning

Slides.name: reorderSlides
Slides.description: Completely reorders all slides in the deck according to an array of 1-based indices.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Rebuilds <p:sldIdLst> order in ppt/presentation.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Order array length must match total slide count and contain valid slide indices without duplicates.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Array of 1-based slide indices reflecting desired sequence (e.g. [3, 1, 2]).

Slides.exampleCode: ppt.reorderSlides([3, 1, 2]);

Slides.name: tagSlide
Slides.description: Assigns a custom string identifier/tag to a slide for semantic referencing in useSlide() or getSlide().
Slides.openXmlImpact: Attaches tag identifier into slide non-visual custom properties or comment streams.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws SlideNotFoundError if slideIndex is invalid.

parameters.name: slideIndex
parameters.description: 1-based slide index.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Custom identifier name (e.g., 'ExecutiveSummary', 'PricingGrid').

Slides.exampleCode:
ppt.tagSlide(1, 'ExecutiveSummary');
ppt.useSlide('ExecutiveSummary').replaceText({ '{{title}}': 'Updated Title' });

Slides.name: getSlideDimensions
Slides.description: Retrieves the presentation canvas dimensions, aspect ratio preset (16:9 widescreen, 4:3 standard, custom), and pixel/EMU coordinates.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Reads <p:sldSz> element attributes in ppt/presentation.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Supports both standard presets and arbitrary custom dimensions.

returns.description: { width: number, height: number, widthEmu: number, heightEmu: number, type: string }

Slides.exampleCode:
const dims = ppt.getSlideDimensions();
console.log(`Slide aspect: ${dims.type}, Width: ${dims.width}px, Height: ${dims.height}px`);

Slides.name: getSlideLayout
Slides.description: Retrieves the layout configuration, layout master reference, and placeholder layout map for a given slide.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Resolves slide layout relationship in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels.
Slides.edgeCases: Defaults to active slide if slideIndex is omitted.

parameters.name: slideIndex
parameters.description: 1-based slide index.

returns.description: { name: string, type: string, master: string, rId: string }

Slides.exampleCode:
const layout = ppt.getSlideLayout(1);
console.log(`Slide 1 uses layout: ${layout.name} under master: ${layout.master}`);

Slides.name: useSection
Slides.description: Selects all slides contained within a specific section (group of slides) to target for subsequent batch operations (such as text replacements, table updates, chart modifications, or formatting).
Slides.openXmlImpact: Resolves slide IDs registered under the target <p14:section> block in ppt/presentation.xml and updates the internal #selectedSlides state context.
Slides.edgeCases: Supports section name, section UUID string, or 1-based index of a slide within the section. Throws SectionNotFoundError if the target section is not found.

parameters.name: sectionRef
parameters.description: Section display name, section UUID string, or a 1-based index of any slide inside the desired section.

returns.description: Chainable presentation instance targeting all slides within the specified section.

Slides.name: addSection
Slides.description: Creates a new named section grouping slides together starting from a specified slide index.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Appends a <p14:section> entry to <p14:sectionLst> inside ppt/presentation.xml (or presentation extension lists) and associates slide IDs.
Slides.edgeCases: Clamps startSlideIndex within [1, slideCount]. If a section with the same name exists, generates a unique identifier or renames gracefully.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Display name of the section group.

parameters.name: startSlideIndex
parameters.description: 1-based index of the first slide belonging to this section.

Slides.name: updateSection
Slides.description: Updates metadata, display name, or slide assignments of an existing slide section.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Updates attributes (name, id) and slide reference nodes under the corresponding <p14:section> block.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws SectionNotFoundError if sectionIdentifier does not resolve to an existing section ID or name.

parameters.name: sectionIdentifier
parameters.description: Name or UUID of the target section to modify.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration object containing newName (string) or slideIndices (number[]).

Slides.name: removeSection
Slides.description: Deletes a section. Slides within the section are preserved and merged into the previous section unless removeSlides is explicitly set to true.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Deletes the matching <p14:section> element from <p14:sectionLst>. If removeSlides is true, also purges member <p:sldId> nodes and associated slide XML parts.
Slides.edgeCases: Throws SectionNotFoundError if section does not exist. Prevents removing the only remaining section if removeSlides is true and deck would be left slide-less.

parameters.name: sectionIdentifier
parameters.description: Section name or identifier to remove.

parameters.name: removeSlides
parameters.description: If true, also removes all slides contained within the section.

Slides.name: getSection
Slides.description: Retrieves metadata, slide count, and member slide references for a specific section group by name, UUID identifier, or 1-based slide index belonging to that section.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Reads and parses the matching <p14:section> element inside ppt/presentation.xml (or presentation extension lists) in read-only mode.
Slides.edgeCases: Returns null or throws SectionNotFoundError if the target section name, UUID, or slide index does not resolve to an existing section.

parameters.name: sectionRef
parameters.description: Section display name, section UUID string, 1-based member slide index, or array of slide references.

returns.description: Section metadata object: { id: string, name: string, startSlideIndex: number, slideCount: number, slideIndices: number[] }, or null if not found.

Slides.name: hideSlide
Slides.description: Hides one or more slides from the slide show view without deleting slide XML, elements, or relationship data.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Sets show="0" on the root <p:sld> element inside ppt/slides/slideN.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Idempotent if the slide is already hidden. Supports 1-based indices, slide IDs, or custom tags.

parameters.name: slideRefs
parameters.description: 1-based slide indices, IDs, or tags to hide. Defaults to the active slide.

Slides.name: unhideSlide
Slides.description: Restores visibility of one or more hidden slides so they appear during slide shows.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Removes the show attribute (or sets show="1") on the root <p:sld> element inside ppt/slides/slideN.xml.
Slides.edgeCases: No-op if slide is already visible. Throws SlideNotFoundError if index is out of bounds.

parameters.name: slideRefs
parameters.description: 1-based slide indices, IDs, or tags to unhide. Defaults to the active slide.

Slides.name: resetSlide
Slides.description: Clears all custom user elements, text, shapes, charts, and tables from a slide, resetting it to an empty canvas while preserving slide layout bindings and master relationships.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Empties children under <p:spTree> (retaining non-visual group properties <p:nvGrpSpPr> and <p:grpSpPr>) and purges orphaned entries in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels.
Slides.edgeCases: Preserves slide dimensions, master layouts, and background theme elements unless preservePlaceholders option is configured otherwise.

parameters.name: slideRef
parameters.description: 1-based slide index, ID, or custom tag. Defaults to active slide.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Reset options (e.g. preservePlaceholders: boolean, clearNotes: boolean).

Slides.name: addComment
Slides.description: Attaches a collaborative review comment to one or more slides or to a targeted shape/coordinate position, attributing the author, timestamp, and optional comment thread parent.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Creates or updates ppt/comments/commentN.xml and ppt/commentAuthors.xml, establishes the comment relationship in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels, and registers the comment content type override in [Content_Types].xml.
Slides.edgeCases: Generates a unique author ID index in commentAuthors.xml if the author does not already exist. Defaults to targeting the active slide index if slideRef is omitted.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Body text content of the review comment.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Comment metadata, author profile, and positioning options.

parameters.name: options.author
parameters.description: Display name of the comment author.

parameters.name: options.initials
parameters.description: Initials of the comment author.

parameters.name: options.slideRef
parameters.description: 1-based slide index or custom tag where the comment will be pinned.

parameters.name: options.x
parameters.description: Horizontal pin coordinate position (in pixels, inches, or EMUs).

parameters.name: options.y
parameters.description: Vertical pin coordinate position (in pixels, inches, or EMUs).

returns.description: Resolves to the chainable presentation templater instance.

Slides.name: removeComment
Slides.description: Removes one or all collaborative review comments from a slide by comment index, comment ID, author name, or regex pattern.
Slides.openXmlImpact: Deletes the matching <p:cm> element inside ppt/comments/commentN.xml and purges the relationship from ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels and [Content_Types].xml if no comments remain on the slide.
Slides.edgeCases: If commentIdentifier is omitted, purges all comments on the targeted slide. Throws SlideNotFoundError if the slide reference is invalid.

parameters.name: commentIdentifier
parameters.description: 1-based comment index, comment ID, author name, or text pattern to remove. If omitted, removes all comments on the slide.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional targeting configuration.

parameters.name: options.slideRef

Tables.name: styleTable
Tables.description: Applies table-wide styling, alternating row/column bands, headers, and borders.
Tables.openXmlImpact: Configures <a:tblPr> properties and iterates <a:tcPr> cells applying alternating solid fills and borders.
Tables.edgeCases: Supports headerFill, oddFill, evenFill, bandRow, bandCol, and border presets.

parameters.name: tableId
parameters.description: Table name or shape ID.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Styling options (firstRow, bandRow, headerFill, oddFill, evenFill, border, fontSize).

Tables.exampleCode: ppt.styleTable('SalesTable', { headerFill: '1E3A8A', oddFill: 'F8FAFC', evenFill: 'FFFFFF', border: { color: 'CBD5E1', width: 1 } });

Tables.name: styleColumn

Tables.openXmlImpact: Mutates <a:tcPr> and text properties of every cell in the column.
